title: Endpoint coherence
statement: The stated intermediate equality for the coefficient transition.

proof.text: Name the homology functor H, derived direct image R, triangle transition l, single-complex comparison s and fixed coefficient identification c. The elementary categorical identity H.map l ≫ H.map (R.map (s ≫ c)) = H.map (l ≫ R.map s) ≫ H.map (R.map c) follows from Functor.map_comp and Category.assoc. Identify its left and right sides with the stated maps by unfolding only the shared coefficient, shared single complex and canonical transition definitions. Construct explicit heterogeneous congruence proofs for the differing proof arguments before converting to ordinary equality; this avoids expensive kernel normalization of the derived-category objects. The congruence proof generator is adapted from HigherDirectImageRawTransitionToHomCore and every generated proof is checked by Lean. No object is chosen, and the identity holds in every integer degree.

proof_origin.place: Tags 03Q8 and 09Z1; B2 writes out elementary functoriality, adapting the existing kernel-checked congruence generator from HigherDirectImageRawTransitionToHomCore.
